evidence_snapshots.description: Evidence paths containing sanduq.evidence.snapshot.v1 capture descriptors. Admission and freshness validate retained Git references and exact file proofs through evidence_snapshot.resolve.

fingerprints.description: SHA-256 per path; a dependency on the configured Project Sync state is sync-binding:v1:<sha256> of the bound feature's entry without status and timestamp fields (1.16.0+), a raw hash before; a feature's workflow/decisions.json is decision-records:v1:<ids>:<sha256> of the decisions that existed when the receipt was recorded (after 1.22.1), a raw hash before.

source_fingerprints.description: Legacy inline source inventory (before 1.13.0); still read.

source_inventory.description: Written by the runtime only: the source inventory side file, relative to the feature directory (workflow/inventory/<stage>-<claim_id>[-<suffix>].json), and the SHA-256 of its bytes.

text_fingerprints.description: Written by the runtime only: whitespace-normalised hashes of Markdown fingerprints, read by revalidate-upstream's drift decision.

effort_score.description: Scope only: the effort score that selects the tier; required when profiles are enabled.

lazy.description: Tasks-to-Issues under issue_sync.taskstoissues phase-lazy: only the first phase is mapped.

revalidated_upstream.description: Written by the runtime only: the revalidate-upstream episode that re-recorded or re-stamped this receipt.

pr_lint_binding.description: Runtime-owned recomputed exact-body lint binding to native Scope prerequisites.

input_roles.description: Optional declared role per input path; every key is listed in inputs. A receipt without it is read as all-dependency.

amendments.description: Assessed evidence amendments recorded by workflow.py amend. Written by the runtime only.

stale.description: Written by the runtime only. evidence-amended: a changed amendment of earlier evidence undermined this receipt; it must be re-recorded. ci-lane-gap: a CI run offered as Verify evidence missed lanes the source drift affects; a run covering them closes it through revalidate.

head.description: Optional commit the receipt was recorded at.

source_key.description: Optional canonical source key at head, distinct from source_fingerprints. Without it the identity rule applies.

ci_evidence.description: Optional CI run accepted as verification evidence, written by workflow.py revalidate --stage verify --check-run only. The gate accepts a Verify receipt whose source drifted only when the record is complete (every field revalidate writes, well-formed), this run concluded success on the current source key with no lane gap, and the gate re-reads the run through the GitHub API.

diff_reviewed.description: Optional record of an incremental review of the source diff <base>..<head>, written by workflow.py revalidate --stage review --diff-reviewed only. Since 1.6.1 it records diff_sha256, the SHA-256 of the exact diff-tree output the evidence names, and the reviewer.

revalidations.description: Checked revalidations of a Verify, Review or Ready receipt after source drift (workflow.py revalidate). Written by the runtime only; an entry with outcome stale records a lane gap and changed nothing else.

delegation_ledger_trust.description: Written by the runtime only, on a stage whose claim recorded a delegation route (workflow.py complete, 1.7+, round 3): the tri-state trust read of the delegation ledger at completion time. 'trusted' or 'unverified-local' (no local dispatcher-write marker, the normal state for a fresh checkout or CI runner) are recorded as a warning; 'untrusted' refuses completion and is never stored.

native_attestation.description: Written by the runtime only, when the ledger attempt that let complete accept a delegated stage is a native attestation (delegate_dispatch.py attest-native): the stage was done by a native subagent of the host and attested by the top-level session. Self-asserted; no external ledger evidence backs it, and it is never a dispatched run.
